Man Utd summary from the PSG friendly 👇 Mbeumo started CF (5 shots, 4 on target) and took corners/FKs before Bruno's introduction. Dorgu LW and Amad RW. Early injury for Mount (who started CM) and a knock for Shaw. Youri Tielemans 6 DEFCON in a 26 minute cameo for the fans 😅
